title: RubikSQL-HB: Agentic Text-to-SQL with Knowledge in the Loop
abstract: arXiv:2611.32772v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Database agents need more than schema structure: business meanings, stored values and reference queries supply knowledge that becomes relevant at different points in reasoning. We introduce RubikSQL-HB, which exposes these materials through queryable, database-specific knowledge workspaces built on the HeavenBase platform. Its knowledge interface remains available as an agent constructs and investigates an answer. Candidate agents interleave knowledge access with SQL construction and execution; a downstream Judge can reuse the same interfaces to investigate disagreements. A two-stage example interface separates discovering a reference question from expanding its SQL. On a 500-question BIRD Mini-Dev evaluation, the full pipeline reaches 75.2% execution accuracy, against 71.2% for first-candidate selection and 70.4% for execution-majority voting, with a correct candidate available on 79.0% of questions. translated_title: RubikSQL-HB：知识在环的智能体式 Text-to-SQL
translated_abstract: 数据库智能体需要的不仅仅是模式结构信息：业务含义、存储的数值和参考查询所提供的知识会在推理的不同阶段变得相关。我们提出 RubikSQL-HB，它通过构建在 HeavenBase 平台之上的可查询、针对特定数据库的知识工作区来开放这些材料。在智能体构建并核查答案的整个过程中，其知识接口始终可用。候选智能体将知识访问与 SQL 的构建和执行交错进行；下游的裁判可以通过复用相同的接口来调查候选之间的分歧。一个两阶段的示例接口将“发现参考问题”与“扩展其 SQL”分离开来。在包含 500 个问题的 BIRD Mini-Dev 评估上，完整流水线达到了 75.2% 的执行准确率，相比之下首次候选选择为 71.2%，执行多数投票为 70.4%，且有 79.0% 的问题存在正确候选。（注：原文摘要在"原始知识条件"部分被截断，此处仅翻译到已有内容。）
tldr: RubikSQL-HB 通过 HeavenBase 平台上可查询的数据库专属知识工作区，将业务含义、存储值和参考查询等知识持续融入 Text-to-SQL 智能体的推理全程，使候选生成与下游裁判都能随时访问知识进行核查与仲裁，在 BIRD Mini-Dev 上达到 75.2% 的执行准确率，显著优于首次候选选择和多数投票策略。
en_tdlr: RubikSQL-HB integrates business meanings, stored values, and reference queries into every stage of Text-to-SQL agent reasoning through queryable, database-specific knowledge workspaces built on HeavenBase, allowing candidate agents and a downstream Judge to continuously access knowledge for verification and arbitration, achieving 75.2% execution accuracy on BIRD Mini-Dev and outperforming first-candidate selection and majority voting.
